ForestPlatTileSize.name: Flying turn blocks graphics routine
summary: Table: OAM size bits for the five tiles (2 = 16x16). Then the draw routine (called from FlyingTurnBlocks): draws 5 tiles from the
ForestPlat* tables; [$14] bit 3 picks the table half (wing animation). Tiles written with varying sizes (Y = $FF), A = 4 for FinishOAMWrite.

GrayLavaPlatform.name: Gray lava platform main
summary: Draws, then handles the platform: Mario can stand on it; standing on it starts a $40-frame sink timer ($1540) with Y speed 6.
When the timer reaches 1 the sprite is removed and its load status reset so it respawns from level data.

LavaPlatTiles.name: Gray lava platform graphics
summary: Tables: tile numbers and properties for the three 16x16 tiles, then the draw routine that places them 16 pixels apart.

MegaMoleSpeed.name: Table: Mega Mole X speed by direction

MegaMole.name: Mega Mole main
summary: Draws, then (if status 8 and sprites not locked) walks left/right at $10/$F0, updates position and sprite contacts.
Remembers whether it was on the ground this frame ($0A frame grace timer in $1540 after leaving the ground).

MegaMoleInAir.name: Mega Mole: airborne this frame
summary: Pops the saved on-ground bit; if it was on the ground last frame, starts the $0A-frame timer in $1540.

MegaMoleWasInAir.name: Mega Mole: ledge grace timer
summary: While the $1540 timer runs, Y speed is held at 0 so it walks off ledges smoothly.

MegaMoleOnGround.name: Mega Mole: turn at walls, Mario contact
summary: Turns around on wall contact (with a $10-frame turn timer $15AC for the graphics direction $151C).
Mario touching it from above (not too high, falling) lets Mario ride on it; touching from the side hurts Mario.

MegaMoleNoYoshi.name: Mega Mole: carry Mario
summary: Puts Mario on top of the Mega Mole (Y offset differs with Yoshi) and moves him horizontally by [$1491] (+1/-1).

MegaMoleContact.name: Mega Mole: hurt Mario on side contact
summary: Hurts Mario unless he is riding it, or it is being eaten by Yoshi.

MegaMoleTileDispX.name: Table: Mega Mole tile X offsets
summary: 8 entries: 4 tiles for facing left, then 4 for facing right.

MegaMoleTileDispY.name: Table: Mega Mole tile Y offsets

MegaMoleTiles.name: Table: Mega Mole tile numbers
summary: Two animation frames of four 16x16 tiles each, per direction.

MegaMoleGfxRt.name: Mega Mole graphics routine
summary: Draws four 16x16 tiles (2x2). Animation frame from [$14] and the sprite's slot index; flips horizontally when facing right.

BatTiles.name: Table: Swooper tile numbers
summary: Tile per graphics frame ($1602): 0 = hanging, 1-2 = wings up/down.

Swooper.name: Swooper bat main
summary: Uses GenericSprGfxRt2, replaces the tile by frame. If not status 8 falls to the upside-down death drawing.
Otherwise processes sprite interaction, moves, and runs a state machine: 0 = waiting, 1 = swooping down, 2 = flying horizontally.

s0388E0.name: Table: Swooper X speed limits and acceleration
summary: Max X speed $10/$F0 and acceleration +1/-1, indexed by direction.

s0388E4.name: Swooper state routines
summary: $0388E4: waiting; wakes when Mario is within $50 pixels horizontally.
$038905: swooping down; Y speed decays, X accelerates toward Mario's side.
$038936: flying horizontally with bobbing Y speed (Blurp tables).

s038954.name: Table: Sliding Koopa speed limits and acceleration
summary: Max X speed $20/$E0 and acceleration +2/-2, indexed by direction.

SlidingKoopa.name: Sliding Koopa (shell-less blue) main
summary: Faces its movement direction, draws; slides down slopes accelerating, decelerates on flat ground.
When it stops, a $20-frame timer ($1558) runs, then it becomes a shell-less blue Koopa (sprite 02). Makes smoke particles while sliding.
$0389FF: spawns a smoke image in a free slot ($17C0-$17C3) every 4th frame while moving.

BowserStatue.name: Bowser statue main
summary: Draws, then runs a state routine: 0 sits, 1 and 3 breathe fire, 2 jumps toward Mario. Mario can stand on it.

BowserStatuePtrs.name: Bowser statue states
summary: $038A54 spawns fire and falls into $038A57, which handles standing, gravity and landing.
$038A69: jumping state with wall bounce and a $30-frame wait between jumps.

BwsrStatueSpeed.name: Table: Bowser statue jump X speed

BwserFireDispXLo.name: Table: fire spawn X offset low byte

BwserFireDispXHi.name: Bowser statue fireball spawner
summary: Table of high bytes, then CODE_038ACB: every 128 frames (staggered by slot) spawns sprite B3 (Bowser statue fireball) in front of the statue.

BwsrStatueDispX.name: Table: Bowser statue tile X offsets

BwsrStatueDispY.name: Table: Bowser statue tile Y offsets

BwsrStatueGfxProp.name: Table: Bowser statue tile properties
summary: Per tile: second half X-flipped ($40) for the other direction.

BowserStatueGfx.name: Bowser statue graphics routine
summary: Draws three tiles (a small 8x8 and two 16x16) with direction and frame ($1602) selecting the tables; palette from sprite palette.

s038BAA.name: Table: Bowser statue shake/wave data
summary: Triangular wave from $20 down to 0 up to $20 (probably unused or used by another sprite).
